title: Teaching Children the Rights of Parents and Ihsan (Excellence) Towards Them

text_simplified: Parents must teach their children the rights of parents and ihsan (excellence) towards them. They should also raise their children upon birr (righteousness) and obedience, while being mindful of their feelings and not neglecting them.

review_defects.english: Teaching Children the Rights of Parents and Ihsan (Excellence) Towards Them
review_defects.why: The English title adds 'Towards Them', which is not present in the Arabic title. The Arabic title does not specify the object of ihsan; the addition is an interpretive expansion.
The transliterated term 'Ihsan' is capitalized in the title but appears lowercase in the body text, creating inconsistent capitalization within the same document.
